lines.t: Let the call to repentance go out
Behold the trumpet call of God
Come all nations to the end
The sun raised high
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
A standard lifted, the sleepers wake
The light shines bright, the heart shall quake
A banner waving, the glory unfurls
The King of Heaven calling all the world
From Zion's hill the trumpet sounds
The word of Yahushua spreads all around
Owning a call, a beacon bright
To draw the faithful into His light
Be a part of the trumpet call
Hear the word, the banner for all
Step forward, beloved
Take your stand, join the call across the land
Yahushua, Yahuwah, reigns on high
The trumpet sounds
Redemption Night
The nations stir, the plumb line falls, the righteous rise as judgment calls.
A bright lamp post, a shining flame, the trumpet call proclaims His name.
Thus says the Lord, beloved, this word, even every volume to every letter,
Is the word of my glory
Which I have put forth once again
A testament of my love and sacrifice
The announcement of my coming
A proclamation of truth
Revelation of who I really am
The trumpet call of God
So all those called and chosen
May hear and come to me
In their proper time and season
Behold, it is also a strong correction
For all those who have taken to themselves
My name and my word
to pollute it a plumb line for this wicked generation for this word is a
waving banner an instant to all nations a trumpet of alarm and war the sound of
recompense and judgment which shall soon fall upon every nation
who I am the only begotten of the father the one true God and Savior the Mashiach
Yahushua, Yahuwah!
Come take your place
In the trumpet call
For behold, the King comes
